record.paper_title: Dense ideals in topological algebras: some results and open problems
record.original_question: Let A be a commutative complex unital B0-algebra, that is, a completely metrizable locally convex algebra. Must every multiplicative linear functional on A be continuous?

evidence.quote: Unless otherwise stated, all algebras in this paper will be commutative, complex, unital, with the unity denoted by e.
– The class B0 = LC ∩ F of B0-algebras, their topology is given by means of a sequence of seminorms
Problem 3. Let A be be a commutative algebra of type B0. Is it true that all its multiplicative-linear functionals are continuous ?

artifact.self_contained_problem: A B_0-algebra is a complex associative algebra A endowed with a topology making it a completely metrizable locally convex topological vector space such that multiplication A × A → A is jointly continuous. Equivalently, the topology of A is generated by a countable family of submultiplicative (or at least suitably compatible) seminorms with respect to which A is complete. Assume in addition that A is commutative and possesses a unit element e. A multiplicative linear functional on A is a nonzero linear map φ : A → C satisfying φ(xy) = φ(x)φ(y) for all x, y ∈ A.\n\nQuestion: Must every multiplicative linear functional φ on A be continuous?
artifact.status_search_result: This is the classical Michael problem (E. A. Michael, 1952), asking whether every multiplicative linear functional on a commutative complex unital Fréchet (B_0) algebra is continuous. It remains a well-known open problem in the theory of topological algebras. Affirmative answers have been established only for special subclasses (e.g., Fréchet algebras with bases, certain function algebras), and recent claimed general solutions (such as arXiv:2006.11134) have not been accepted by the community as definitive.

status_evidence.title: Multiplicative Functionals on Fréchet Algebras with Bases
status_evidence.snippet: Partial results on continuity of multiplicative functionals on Fréchet algebras with bases.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial (special-case) results are known toward Michael's problem.

status_evidence.title: On affirmative solution to Michael's acclaimed problem in the theory of Fréchet algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Title explicitly refers to Michael's problem as an acclaimed (long-standing) problem in the theory of Fréchet algebras.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of continuity of multiplicative linear functionals on commutative complex Fréchet algebras is the classical Michael problem, widely regarded as open.
